definitions.gloss: under repair; being repaired; closed for repairs
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something is currently in the process of being repaired or maintained. Commonly seen on signs and notices.

examples.japanese: ⟦エレベーター→エレベーター：01340_erebeetaa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{修理中|しゅうりちゅう}です。
{修理中|しゅうりちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧⟦できません→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: It cannot be used because it is under repair.

examples.japanese: ⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{修理中|しゅうりちゅう}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{今週|こんしゅう}→今週：00721_konshuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦スマートフォン→スマートフォン：04434_sumaatofon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Since my computer is being repaired, I'm working on my smartphone this week.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧ (repair) and ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (in the middle of, during). The suffix ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ is highly productive and attaches to many nouns to indicate an ongoing state.

USAGE:
Very commonly seen on signs posted on equipment, facilities, roads, and buildings. Often appears on its own as a sign: {修理中|しゅうりちゅう}. Can be used as a no-adjective with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {修理中|しゅうりちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧ (a car under repair).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {修理中|しゅうりちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧ — due to being under repair
- ⟦{現在|げんざい}→現在：01556_genzai⟧{修理中|しゅうりちゅう} — currently under repair
- {修理中|しゅうりちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{機器|きき}→機器：13180_kiki⟧ — equipment under repair

SIMILAR PATTERNS:
- ⟦{工事中|こうじちゅう}→工事中：09625_koujichuu⟧ — under construction
- ⟦{点検中|てんけんちゅう}→点検中：10259_tenkenchuu⟧ — under inspection
- {調整中|ちょうせいちゅう} — being adjusted; under adjustment
- ⟦{準備中|じゅんびちゅう}→準備中：09540_junbichuu⟧ — in preparation; not yet open
